discovery.title: Mosquitoes are rapidly activating enzymes against common insecticide, researchers warn
discovery.summary: Traditionally, public health programs have relied on chemicals for mosquito management, which may be why combating mosquitoes is becoming more difficult. Over time, insecticides trigger biochemical and genetic variations that confer a survival advantage on certain mosquito populations.
